_comment: The optimizer commit the Apache and nginx system-test lanes build their
worker and client library (libpagespeed.so) from, when the daemon lane
is on (test/system/optimizer_lane.sh). Any commit on the optimizer's
main branch may be pinned here: tests on this branch are written
against it. Bumping it is a change of optimizer_commit alone.
It must link the same cache-library commit as this module
(bazel/repositories.bzl CYCLONE_COMMIT), or the lane's web server
checks it in the pull request tier and before each lane build.
This is not the release pin: packages and the release lane use
file to run the lanes against the released optimizer instead.
